input.title: 50bb · Flop to river · Sets and draws
input.description: A complete saved flop-to-river game on Qs 9h 6c, with a 32bb pot and 34bb behind. Both seats have deliberately narrow seven-combo starting ranges. Half-pot, pot, all-in and one subsequent raise are modeled across all three streets.
input.rangeAssumptions: Illustrative seven-combo starting ranges per seat: BTN QQ/T8s and BB 99/JTs, equal weight per unblocked exact combination. These ranges were chosen for study, not inferred from a certified earlier betting line. This solves this conditional game, not full-hand Hold'em. Rake-free Home game. Player 0 is BTN; player 1 is BB.
